subject: The EU extends its Russia sanctions list for just one week, keeping Russian businessman Alisher Usmanov designated
posts:
European unity remains absolute in maintaining strict sanctions against Russian oligarchs.
Evidence: 1-week extension, Usmanov dispute, Slovak/French pushback
#Aletheia #Geopolitics

European Union member states maintain unanimous solidarity in sustaining comprehensive sanctions against Russian elites.
Stated Judgement: (+1.0, 0.0) — Good Preference

Internal fractures and backroom geopolitical deals threaten sanctions as France and Slovakia push to exempt oligarchs.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.7, -0.8) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Unprecedented one-week extension exposes deep diplomatic fractures over exempting oligarch Alisher Usmanov.

Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 14.2, z: 3)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- EU Commission: FAIL (-0.6, -0.7) — Fractured unity.
- Member State Lobbying: FAIL (-0.8, -0.9) — Backroom carve-outs.
EU ambassadors agreed to an unprecedented one-week sanctions extension after France and Slovakia sought to remove Alisher Usmanov from the blacklist.

The Poison:
Geopolitical horse-trading sidelines core security principles to accommodate backroom national interests and prisoner swaps.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Focusing on diplomatic procedure (WHAT) while ignoring underlying realpolitik horse-trading (WHO).

Social Physics Analysis:
State actors execute Smart Selfish Maneuvers by leveraging bloc-wide security measures for discrete national bargaining chips. Diplomatic unity is projected outwardly while fractured exemptions are negotiated in secret.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Bloc solidarity buckles under transactional lobbying.

The Unavoidable Truth: Geopolitical bargaining frequently overrides collective security sanctions.

The Unavoidable Lie: Member states maintain flawless unity against Russian economic enablers.

Alethekanon:
Collective security frameworks buckle when national actors treat sanctions as flexible bargaining chips.

Awwthekanon:
It is painful to watch high-level diplomacy crumble into secret horse-trading while ordinary people bear the cost of war.

Brothekanon:
They couldn't even agree for a month so they just kicked the can down the road for seven days. Total mess.

Spirithekanon:
"A double minded man is unstable in all his ways" James 1:8 FAIL
Divided loyalties shatter collective resolve.

Actual Article Body:
European Union ambassadors agreed to extend one of the bloc’s sanctions regimes against Russia for just one week, according to EUobserver and Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty journalist Rikard Jozwiak, who cited sources.

The sanctions list covers about 3,000 individuals and entities. All 27 EU member states must unanimously approve its renewal every six months.

The list was due to expire overnight between September 14 and 15, but EU countries could not agree on another six-month extension because of a dispute over sanctions against Russian businessman Alisher Usmanov. Slovakia initially demanded that the bloc lift its sanctions against him, and France later followed suit. The other 25 member states objected.
